data.steelman: DeFiLlama already reports aggregate seven-day DEX-volume growth of +16.0%, while several major venues, including Uniswap V3, show positive weekly growth. The breadth across established venues supports persistence rather than a single-launch distortion.
data.rebuttal: A positive weekly snapshot is weak evidence for persistence eight months later. The venue table contains jumps of +103.0%, +139.9%, and +153.9%, exactly the kind of unstable base effects, incentives, or concentrated bursts that can inflate an aggregate without proving durable demand. The same table also has PumpSwap down 17.3%, so breadth is not universal. Reported volume is especially gameable because the same capital can be recycled through low-friction venues. The other view must assume today’s acceleration survives normalization; I assign greater weight to mean reversion and the absence of corroborating aggregate TVL or stablecoin-supply data.
